name: restarter
description: Asks to start the first item over, then answers well. The restart resets that item only; the rest runs like strong_specific.

turns.say: Wait, sorry, can I start over? I lost my thread.
At Acme I repair rooftop HVAC units for commercial sites. Since March 2023, about twelve call-outs a week, all logged in the CMMS.
March 2023, and it's still most of my week.
Last month I traced a compressor trip across 6 rooftop units from scratch with the CMMS history and a leak detector, and wrote a three-step repair plan; five cleared.
I started with the units that had tripped in the last 60 days, and ruled out anything under 5 years old.
The diagnosis and the fixes were mine; my supervisor only signed off the first parts order.
I want to work on hospital plant rooms, and this role is that work on commercial sites.
Diagnosing faults from scratch without a supervisor on site and owning the first visit.
